item.title: Rallying Cry – November 3, 2026
item.description: A blood donor completed an epic 545-donation tour across Australia, Indigenous cultural burns are making a comeback in Canada, and an old couple’s joyful dance in Rome reminds us to celebrate life’s simple moments.
